## Purpose
Describe the change and why it is required.

## Scope
- [ ] Smallest relevant change
- [ ] No unrelated refactor
- [ ] Existing architecture/interfaces preserved or change documented

## Security / runtime impact
- [ ] No security-boundary change
- [ ] Credential/secrets impact reviewed
- [ ] Privilege/service impact reviewed
- [ ] Hardware-control impact reviewed

## Documentation
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated or not required

## Validation
List only checks/tests actually performed.

## Rollback
Describe rollback/uninstall where runtime behaviour can change.

## Review
- [ ] Existing issues/open PRs checked for duplication
- [ ] First Codex review findings resolved using the PR review-resolution skill where applicable
- [ ] No secrets or large evidence artifacts committed

Do not merge automatically.
